channel.title: Mohamed Sharfiras — Technical Notes & Architecture
channel.description: Observations and engineering strategies regarding frontend performance, enterprise intranet migrations, Core Web Vitals, and automation by Mohamed Sharfiras.

item.title: Deconstructing Core Web Vitals: How We Cut LCP from 4.2s to 1.1s on High-Traffic eCommerce
item.description: A practical, production-tested teardown of optimizing Largest Contentful Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift, and Interaction to Next Paint on high-traffic multi-region eCommerce stores.

item.title: Building Bulletproof Client Forms: Webhooks, Honeypots, and CRM Sync Without Annoying Users
item.description: Why traditional CAPTCHAs hurt conversion rates by up to 15%, and how to build resilient, spam-proof lead intake pipelines using invisible honeypots, time-stamped validation, and serverless webhook dispatchers.

item.title: Next.js App Router vs Vite SPA in 2026: A Practical Architecture Decision Matrix
item.description: Server-Side Rendering isn't always the answer. An honest, production-tested engineering comparison of when to reach for Next.js App Router versus when a static Vite SPA offers 10x better developer velocity and lower operating costs.

item.title: Lessons from Enterprise Intranet Migrations: Governance, Zero Downtime, and Managing 1,000+ Internal Pages
item.description: Key engineering strategies learned from managing large-scale corporate intranet migrations: maintaining strict design system governance, ensuring WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and preventing broken link catastrophes.

item.title: WordPress vs Custom Development: What I Actually Use for Client Projects in 2026
item.description: When to choose headless WordPress vs Next.js custom architecture for commercial and enterprise client systems.

item.title: How I Build High-Converting Websites as a Developer, Not Just a Designer
item.description: Engineering principles behind conversion rate optimization, page speed impact, and streamlined client acquisition funnels.

item.title: From Static Website to Full System: How I Add Automation to My Web Projects
item.description: Connecting static platforms to automated CRM pipelines, webhooks, and backend notification services.

item.title: 7 Frontend Mistakes That Are Killing Your Website Performance (And How to Fix Them)
item.description: Practical debugging strategies for Cumulative Layout Shift, unoptimized JavaScript bundles, and main thread blocking.

item.title: Why Most Business Websites Fail in 2026 (And How to Fix Yours Fast)
item.description: Analyzing common failure points in commercial web platforms and how structured technical SEO and speed restore ROI.
